critique.evidence: Frame pacing is stable: composer samples average about 15.1–16.2 ms with worst frames at 16.8 ms, and overall long-frame ratio is 0 across all viewports. However, standard mode recorded 0 active animations and 0 changed elements on desktop, tablet, and mobile, so no actual transition quality, easing, or interaction feedback is demonstrated. Reduced-motion matches the media query and shows no visual changes, but still reports 1 active animation in every viewport, leaving incomplete proof that motion is fully suppressed.
critique.fix: Capture measured interaction sequences for slider, toggle, launch/loading, and results-state transitions with enough frames to assess easing and continuity. Ensure prefers-reduced-motion cancels every animation rather than leaving an active animation, then provide timing evidence for both modes across all viewports.
